# Project Direction

## Intent

Stress-test whether LoopThing should be a compression-first product or a pretty viewer.

## Problem

People copy-paste old AI chats into new chats because they know there is gold in there, but the raw transcript grabs everything.

## Killed Paths

### Memory But Better

Killed because labs can ship single-player memory with deeper integration and better default distribution.

### Viewer-First Product

Killed because a beautiful viewer can hide weak compression. If the artifact does not find the gold, the viewer is theatre.

### Format Spec First

Killed because a format is only interesting once the artifact is useful.

## Where The Explanation Might Be Wrong

- Compression quality might fail on real messy chats.
- Handoff may be too rare to be a business.
- The category may arrive later than the runway.

## Next Action

Run the compression test on 20 real chats before building more UI.

## Asks

- Does handoff resonate as the wedge?
- Bring one messy chat for the private compression challenge.
